text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! It's all-or-nothing! If it fails, 
we'll get ripped to shreds. Butâ

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Bring it on! Come at me, Kris S! And all 
you world-class powerhouses!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This is my—our way of running! 
Uoooryaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was truly a fearless run. A brave dash, 
smashing through the crashing waves of the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Yes! Yes, yes, YES! Come on!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This is how you wire a 2,400m race from 
the front! A dazzling show right along the 
inner rail! It's Tap Dance City!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
With a shocking front-running escape 
reminiscent of Katsuragi Ace, she blew the 
entire world away!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: HECK YEAAAAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text: YEEEEEESSSSSSS!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She rejoiced every bit as much as the 
person herself. And so—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pushing past her limits on the track, Tap 
Dance City repaid the favor. And what's 
more—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The legendary breakaway runaway was 
brilliantly resurrected at Fuchu, and 
unleashed upon the world once more.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, listen, everyone. Let me just say one 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing in the winner's circle, Tap Dance 
City looked a bit more serious than usual.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"There's just one thing I want to say. 
I... I just..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: I love my teammates!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I love you to death! I wanna be with you 
24/7! I wanna play and laugh together with 
you for all eternity!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
How could I not take that friend to the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe?! There's no way 
I couldn't?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"So I stopped myself. I held back for the 
day when we could all go together."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"We're just penniless nobodies down to our 
last cent. Just a ragtag bunch thrown 
together, after all."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Did you see, everyone? Did you see how I 
ran today?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Can my running hold up on the world 
stage? If you saw it, you'd know... 
right!?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"If you feel a burning current within, 
cheer for me. Next is the Arima Kinen. 
And――"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Wealthy magnates of the world watching 
this! Give me a chance!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Give us a chance! A chance to take on the 
world and survive!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: That's all! See you soon!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Along with a thoroughly satisfying 
victory, Tap Dance City left behind a 
powerful message.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That was an undeniable performance, Tap.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thanks, Ace! You're the one who 
inspired me to throw myself into the 
racing world...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Being able to run the same way feels 
incredible! So much so that I want to bust 
open an entire barrel of grape juice and 
chug it down!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we did everything we needed to 
do, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With this victory, all we can do now is 
wait for something to happen."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Getting reached out to by major global 
sponsors, or being invited to prestigious 
races with VIP treatment, and so on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It all depends on how the people who 
received Tap Dance City's message feel 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. In that case, all 
that's left is to seal the deal.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Shall we go to the "Arima Kinen"? Let's 
raise hell one last time this year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If offers come in from wealthy owners and 
keep our overseas dream alive, that'll be 
next year. In preparation for that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's cap this off with the greatest 
finale of the year at the Arima Kinen.
